latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor for PC — Edit and Export Videos Online:

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos (up to 500MB) and request trims, transitions, edits, and 1080p exports—all handled online.
- Automated backend setup: free token generation, session creation, and quick authentication on first use.
- Intuitive prompts route actions like edit, export, credit check, and upload; supports multiple formats and batch processing.
- Fast cloud rendering (30–90 seconds/job) with simple download links; all processing on cloud GPUs—no install required.
- Clear error handling for expired tokens, unsupported files, lack of credits, and missing headers.
- Designed for PC users and content creators seeking fast, high-quality edits without complex software.
